system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: These adjustments are triggered by execution feedback and implemented through carefully crafted prompt templates that guide the Manager toward appropriate planning modifications.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only. The pinned OSWorld ref (2024-06-23) predates mm_agents/maestro, so no prompt-building code is available.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The Manager incorporates a supplement mechanism that leverages external knowledge sources (web search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems) to enhance task understanding and fill information gaps.
env_context_strategy.note: Screenshot-grounded objective alignment plus web/RAG supplement. The retrieval type is unspecified.

context_compaction.note: Maestro code is not in the pinned repo and the paper does not describe history handling.

observation_format.evidence_quote: it provides system coordination capabilities through Screenshot for visual state capture

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: It supports both Python and Bash scripting environments and implements secure execution boundaries to prevent system compromise.
tool_call_format.note: Technician runs scripts. The Operator action syntax (agent.click(x,y), Fig. 2) has an unknown parser.

tool_count.note: No tool registry in evidence. The paper lists about 14 Operator actions but does not give a schema.

protocol_standardization.note: Maestro source and dependencies are absent at the pinned ref.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Failed quality checks return the system to REPLAN, enabling the Manager to perform light, medium, or heavy adjustments based on failure severity.
loop_primitives.note: FSM controller over plan, act, evaluator gate and replan.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Our system comprises four components: a Controller, a Manager, three Workers

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The Worker subsystem receives role assignments based on subtask characteristics
delegation_mechanism.note: Workers also share artifacts (Memorize), which resembles a shared channel.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Formally, we define the global state as a tuple

long_term_memory.note: The paper mentions a RAG knowledge base but does not say whether it persists across runs.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The Evaluator component also uses o3 for comprehensive quality assessment and gate decision-making.

retry_policy.note: Within-run replanning is capped at 10 attempts (Sec. 3.6). That is not a whole-task retry.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: These safeguards prevent infinite loops and ensure resource-bounded operation while maintaining execution flexibility for complex tasks.
termination_condition.note: Done signals come from workers (Sec. 3.4). max_steps is 50 (Fig. 2). Stagnation detection triggers a quality check or replan, not necessarily a stop.

timeouts.evidence_quote: maximum state switches (default: 100), task runtime limits, and execution step boundaries

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: a deterministic VM snapshot capturing the initial desktop state
execution_isolation.note: The OSWorld environment runs on VMware, VirtualBox, AWS or Azure.

permission_model.note: The paper claims 'secure execution boundaries' but gives no mechanism.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: You can then run the following command to obtain the result:
eval_hooks.note: Evaluation comes from the OSWorld repo that hosts the agent.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Autonomous agents for desktop automation struggle with complex multi-step tasks

model_agnostic.note: The paper uses o3 and UI-TARS. No client abstraction is visible.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/xlang-ai/OSWorld/tree/main/mm_agents/maestro
primary_artifact.note: The pinned ref v0.1.16 (2024-06-23) predates maestro, so coding relies on the paper.

first_release_date.note: Only arXiv v2 (16 Sep 2025) is in the evidence. No tag or v1 date is available.

pinned_version.note: This pin does not contain mm_agents/maestro and should be re-pinned. Only a short hash is available.
